programme.title: The Zoo

programme.title: Treehouse Masters

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People

programme.desc: Hiss of Death: A spitting cobra takes aim at snake catcher Siouxsie's face. Plus, a rats' nest causes a stir and an elusive black mamba hides within strike range. (S3, ep 2)

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Desert Killers: Only the toughest can survive Africa's dunes and deserts. This episode, come face-to-face with some of the continent's deadliest creatures. 7+ (S8, ep 3)

programme.title: Zoo: Disney's Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Gesundheit, Jolo!: A manatee battles a perilous infection, an elephant throws a tantrum, a cheetah has tummy trouble and a tiny chick eats mammoth amounts. 7+ (S2 10/10)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Down in the Ducks: Dr Erin treats a golden retriever with a mysterious illness and removes a massive tumour from a senior pug. (S2, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Wild Mediterranean
programme.desc: Heartlands: Iconic creatures thrive in the remote inland habitats of the Mediterranean - but for all species, raising the next generation is the ultimate goal. 7+ (1 of 2)

programme.title: Wild Mediterranean
programme.desc: Untamed Coasts: A wealth of wildlife, including some of the world's most remarkable survivors, call the serene waters along the Mediterranean coastline home. 7+ (2 of 2)

programme.title: Investigation Shark Attack
programme.desc: Tigers in Hawaii: Three surfers and a kayaker encounter tiger sharks in Oahu, so the team investigates their hunting patterns to discover what is causing these incidents. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: 1920s: Chris explores the R101 airship, as well as post-WWI motorbikes, lorries and petrol pumps, and the decade's obsession with motor racing. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Foal's Gold: It's all hands on deck as Dr Oakley castrates a once-wild stallion. But will the newly gelded horse succeed in getting three mares pregnant? (S7, ep 4)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Baby Makes Three: It's baby season at the zoo! Keepers hope for a long-awaited sand cat kitten, a pregnant bat prepares to pop and endangered wolves go on a blind date. 7+ (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Reefs: Beneath the waves on Africa's southern coast lies one of the most competitive and cut-throat underwater environments in the world. 7+ (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Grasslands: Sustaining more large animals than any other habitat, Africa's vast grasslands are home to some of the greatest wildlife gatherings on Earth. 7+ (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Land, Sea, and Space: A deep dive into Columbia, Deepwater Horizon and Fukushima as experts rewind each disaster with 3D tech to expose the warnings and flaws behind them. (S1, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Black Ice Battle: When a stuck truck blocks a main road, Thord has to rescue it - but the driver doesn't want to pay, so Thord threatens him with house arrest. (S5, ep 5) 7+
